data.narrative:
NODA AI, a Series A defense and security AI company founded by Philong Duong and Dave Corbett, is currently valued at $125M post-money following $29M in total funding. The valuation assessment triangulates across a peer universe of 10 comparables: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in Defense & Security at Series A and adjacent stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to subsequent rounds, yielding $250M. Peer-median analysis across 9 same-sector comparables—including Dream Security ($3.0B Series B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B)—establishes a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range from $300M to $3.0B. These peers span Series B primarily, reflecting the venture depth in this sector.

The triangulated valuation range is $212M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $625M. The current $125M valuation sits materially below both method-implied points, suggesting upside potential, though meaningful uncertainty exists around near-term revenue trajectory and competitive positioning relative to the peer set. The wide interquartile range ($212M–$1.1B) reflects heterogeneity in peer outcomes and stage-specific comparability constraints.
